candidate.reference_selection: Observed frame in the originally kept appearance class, selected with the reviewed cut points to minimize predicted boundary RMS. No blended or invented pixels.
candidate.meaning: Keep the more contrasting observed state steady during this interval; review both states. This may be instructional content.

policy.selection: Minimize worst predicted boundary RGB RMS, then sum, then maximize held duration. Observed references stay in the originally kept appearance class. Trim only; never extend the detected interval. Preserve first and last clip frames.

boundary_alignment.scope: Predicted selected-box RGB and selected-mean changes. Encoded selected/influence RGB and linear-mean checks independently decide acceptance.
